Fee is an estimate after the fix: one surcharge percentage per file, so a file mixing US and non-US buyers will not agree to the cent; Lemon Squeezy's per-fee rounding is unpublished
Orders are not assigned to payouts by the 1st/15th schedule and hold; the user must export one payout's orders

verdict: On arrival the fix recorded against the 2026-11-13 audit (PR 15600) had closed 3 of 13 defects: the eyebrow, the deposit parse and the date_utc alias. It had only documented the two high-severity input defects, so the tool still refused Lemon Squeezy's own Orders export. Scores are unchanged from the first audit except claims (0 to 1, for the honest note); the subject does not meet the bar. PR 18611, by the same session, reads the export (cents, discounts, status, merchant-of-record tax), estimates the fee at 5% + 50c plus a surcharge, books payout fees, removes the Patreon residue and adds tests that catch all four seeded mutants. A later round should re-audit it, ideally against a real export, which no session has had.
